notes.title: Bonus characters update
notes.content:
Version 1.1 is live!

Daggerella and Knight Guy join the fray!  Six new fairy arts, loads of new dialog, two new stages, and two new endings!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 : June 30th, 2023
Changes:

[list]
[*]Added a run log for debugging purposes. This log will appear in the same directory that your configuration, replays, palettes, etc. are saved in.
[*]Fixed a small memory leak in the Windows controller system. This leak only occurred during shutdown, so it had no effect during game play.
[/list]
